# Warlock Create Warlock

> Package: `create-warlock`

> Project scaffolder for the Warlock.js framework — interactive wizard and non-interactive CLI for creating new apps.

## Skills

- [create-a-warlock-project](create-warlock/create-a-warlock-project/SKILL.md): Scaffold a brand-new Warlock.js project with `create-warlock` — fully headless by default (at most one prompt — API-only vs full-stack web) plus `--interactive`/`--customize` for the full long-form wizard. Every flag (`--name`, `--stack`, `--db`, `--pm`, `--features`, `--ai`, `--agents`, `--git/--no-git`, `--jwt/--no-jwt`, `--no-db`, `--yes`, `--interactive`), every valid database-driver / feature / AI-provider / agent-kit-target key, opting out of a database (`--db=none` / `--no-db`, which removes `src/config/database.ts`), the post-scaffold decisions summary, and the directory tree the template emits. Triggers: `create-warlock`, `npm create warlock`, `npx create-warlock`; "scaffold a warlock app", "start a new warlock project", "create-warlock flags", "non-interactive warlock scaffold", "scaffold without a database", "which features can I pass to create-warlock", "agent-kit targets". Skip: running an already-created project (`@warlock.js/core/run-app/SKILL.md`); adding a feature to an existing project (`warlock add`, `@warlock.js/core/add-connector/SKILL.md`); generating a module inside a project (`@warlock.js/core/create-module/SKILL.md`).
